title: Earthy Winey Greek Chickpeas Revithia
description: A hearty, plant-based Greek dish featuring chickpeas in a rich red wine jelly sauce, cooked in a traditional ttukbaegi earthenware pot and wrapped in pandan leaves.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the red wine jelly, olive oil, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chopped onion and minced garlic to the bowl and stir to combine.
Add the chickpeas to the bowl and toss to coat with the sauce.
Spoon the chickpea mixture into a ttukbaegi earthenware pot or a similar clay pot.
Wrap the pot with pandan leaves, securing with kitchen twine if needed.
Bake the revithia for 30 minutes, then reduce the oven temperature to 325 degrees Fahrenheit.
Continue baking for an additional 20 minutes, or until the sauce has thickened and the chickpeas are tender.
Remove the revithia from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
